name: payment-card
title: Payment Card
description: A realistic bank card on any photo or texture — gold or silver EMV chip, contactless mark, embossed number and the real Visa / Mastercard / Amex / RuPay marks. It tilts toward your finger with a moving reflection and flips on tap to the back: magnetic stripe, signature panel with the CVV and a hologram. Frozen state for card controls.
props: Card number (spaces ok). Masked to the last 4 unless masked={false}.
Card art — a photo or texture (require() or { uri }). Soft, blurred photos look premium.
Light text for dark art, dark text for pale art.
Hide every digit but the last four (any card length).
Tap flips the card. false makes a still card (no tilt, no taps) for use inside something tappable, e.g. a CardStack; a controlled flipped still turns it.
Dim the card with a Frozen label and ignore taps.
Corner radius — a real card's corner at phone size.
{ cardholder?, validThru?, frozen?, legal?, back?, accessibility? }
Every built-in string, for translation ({bank} and {last4} are filled in).
